validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE / ROUTE / LENGTH / DIAMETER / STATUS -- CONFIRMED at medium tier via a direct read of the sheet's own cited primary source. Test applied: the sheet's ref (egyptoil-gas.com EGAS Annual Report 2018) FAILS a full-text search for 'operating', '24,20', '2420' etc. -- expected, per scope guidance, since NA's 40 rows were largely identified visually off the GASCO National Gas Grid map, not the report text. I located the map (PDF page 19 of 36 = printed page '35', confirmed by the page's own footer numeral '35'), rendered it at 400dpi, and read it directly. The map shows a distinct, individually labeled '24"/20" 65 k.m' green line running from the orange 'Cairo' hub node, through the 'Arawash P.S' distribution node, directly into the 'Dahshour' compressor-station icon -- i.e. exactly the row's name (Dahshour-Cairo), its length (65 km) and its dual diameter (24 in tapering to 20 in, which is exactly what GEM's comma-separated '24,20' format is for). The line is drawn in the map's pale-green 'EXISTING P/L' line style per the map's own legend (distinct from the red 'UNDER CONS. P/L' style visible elsewhere on the same map, e.g. near El-Tina/Salhia) -- this supports Status=operating as of the report's June 2018 cutoff; 'operating' is inferable from line style, not a literal string in the document, same reasoning already applied to sibling row P8032. PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are correct: it is drawn as a full-weight national-grid trunk line into a major distribution hub, not a thin local/gathering line. ATTRIBUTION: StartState/Province=Giza is correct (Dahshour sits in Giza Governorate, independently established via P8032's research). EndState/Province=Cairo is correct and specifically NOT the same as the separately-labeled '6 October' node (a distinct hub to the west, in Giza Governorate, that carries its own '42" 74 km' line to El Sadat -- that is a different pipeline, P8039 Sadat-Dahshour) -- the 24/20 line terminates at the node explicitly labeled 'Cairo' itself. SECOND-SOURCE CHECK (did not succeed, recorded for the record): (1) GASREG's 'Final Approved TNC April 2020' Section 4.2.4 describes DAHSHOUR Compressor Station's connections by name -- 'El-AMERIA/DAHSHOUR 32"', 'El-Sadat/DAHSHOUR 42"' (inlets), 'DAHSHOUR/ELWASTAA 36"' and 'DAHSHOUR/KORIMAT 36"' (outlets) -- and does NOT mention a Cairo or Tebbin branch. This is silence, not contradiction: the TNC document explicitly states it uses Dahshour only as a worked example ('4.2.3 Pressure Reduction & Metering Stations... about 150 main stations', with only ONE, Dahshour, described in detail) and directs readers to the TSO's own website for 'a complete list of Entry and Exit Points' -- so it is not an exhaustive pipeline registry and its silence carries no evidentiary weight either way. (2) The Egypt Oil & Gas magazine feature 'Egypt's Gas Distribution Network, An Intricate Economic Web' (used to corroborate sibling row P8014) lists other named Delta/Nile-valley lines (Abu Madi-Talkha, Talkha-Tanta-Cairo, Korimat-Al Tebbin, Korimat-Beni Suef, etc.) but does not mention a Dahshour-Cairo line either -- again silence, not contradiction, on a different curated subset of lines. (3) Wikipedia's EGAS company article carries no pipeline-level detail at all. Net: no independent second source was found despite a genuine search across the three most likely candidate documents already in this cohort's citation trail; nothing found anywhere disagrees with the sheet. DUPLICATE CHECK (watchlist): P8040 is structurally distinct from the other two Dahshour-adjacent rows in this scope -- P8032 'Ameriya-Dahshour' (32in, inlet from the west/Alexandria direction) and P8039 'Sadat-Dahshour' (42in, inlet from El Sadat, converging near the separate '6 October' node) -- different diameters, different directions, both already independently confirmed in their own shards. Also not a duplicate of P8021 'Kuraimat-Al Tebbin' or P8014 'Zaafarana-Kuraimat', which run on the opposite (southbound, Upper Egypt) side of the Dahshour hub via the 36in Dahshour/Korimat outlet, a corridor this row does not touch. CLASSIFICATION: correct as transmission/gas, no misfiling found. Caveat driving 'confirmed (caveat)' rather than a clean 'confirmed': every value on this row (length, diameter, route, status) ultimately traces to ONE document (the map image within the EGAS 2018 report) -- a strong, primary, government/state-company source that matches the sheet exactly on every checked field, but single-source per the corroboration standard, so medium tier rather than high.
